summary.zh: 本次更新带来更稳定的模型管理、更可靠的会话记录，以及更流畅的发布流程。技能标签现在会在历史记录和重试中保留。
summary.en: This update brings a more stable model management, more reliable session history, and smoother release process. Skill badges are now preserved across history and retries.

title.zh: 技能标签在历史记录和重试中保留
title.en: Skill badges are preserved in history and retries

summary.zh: 技能标签现在会随会话历史保存，并在重试或恢复时正确显示。
summary.en: Skill badges are now saved with session history and correctly displayed on retry or restore.

details.zh: 历史记录和重试时不再丢失技能标签。
details.en: Skill badges no longer disappear from history or on retry.

details.zh: 分叉会话也能正确读取技能信息。
details.en: Forked sessions can also read skill information correctly.

sources.title: fix(session): persist skill badges across history and retries
build(persistence): repin schema fingerprint for skill list fields

title.zh: 统一模型列表与运行时状态
title.en: Unify model list with runtime state

summary.zh: 左侧栏模型列表现在与运行时状态保持一致，删除模型或切换设置时不会出现错误卡顿。
summary.en: The left rail model list is now consistent with runtime state, avoiding incorrect stalls when deleting models or switching settings.

details.zh: 删除模型后界面立即从权威状态更新，失败时保留卡片。
details.en: The UI updates immediately from authoritative state after deleting a model, and keeps the card on failure.

details.zh: 设置窗口持有统一的运行时目录，所有选择器同步刷新。
details.en: The settings window owns a single runtime directory, all selectors sync refresh.

details.zh: 模型刷新等待异步凭证写入，避免旧快照覆盖新数据。
details.en: Model refresh waits for async credential writes to avoid stale snapshots overwriting newer ones.

details.zh: 写入失败时正确报错，不再假装成功。
details.en: Failures are properly reported on write, no longer appearing successful.

sources.title: fix(settings): unify provider catalog and runtime model state

title.zh: 更新发布前检查的版本快照
title.en: Update version snapshot for release preflight

summary.zh: 发布前的自动检查现在正确识别 v0.1.25，确保发布流程顺畅。
summary.en: The automatic pre-release check now correctly recognizes v0.1.25, ensuring smooth release flow.

details.zh: 预检测试的快照已更新到新版本。
details.en: The preflight test snapshot has been updated to the new version.

sources.title: fix(release): bump preflight snapshot to v0.1.25 / generation 3

title.zh: 提升发布流程的可靠性

summary.zh: 优化了测试和发布相关的自动化配置，减少因拉取深度不足导致的失败。
summary.en: Optimized test and release automation config to reduce failures from insufficient fetch depth.

details.zh: 测试获取完整历史，避免版本检查误判。
details.en: Tests fetch full history to avoid version-check misjudgments.

details.zh: 调整了上传超时设置，使其更稳定。
details.en: Adjusted upload timeout settings for more stability.

sources.title: ci(test): fetch full history so preflight tag test sees real tags
